description: This file defines the Zend_Translate_Adapter_Tmx class, which implements a translation adapter for TMX files within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for loading and parsing TMX translation data, handling XML parsing events, and providing the adapter name.

classes.name: Zend_Translate_Adapter_Tmx
classes.description: A translation adapter class for handling TMX files in Zend Framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TMX adapter with data, locale, and options.

methods.name: _loadTranslationData
methods.description: Loads and parses the TMX translation data from a file.

methods.name: _startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element during parsing.

methods.name: _endElement
methods.description: Handles the end of an XML element during parsing.

methods.name: _contentElement
methods.description: Handles character data within XML elements during parsing.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the adapter.
